The “Attract Love And Ideal Partner” Meditation makes use of Agesta’s sacred codes to catalyze positive transformation in your life. For noticeable results, engage in this meditation for 9, 15, or 21 days.

For faster and more profound results, it is highly recommended to first complete the “Inner Cleanse” meditation sessions.

Believed to be numerical sequences that connect you with higher frequencies, sacred codes help manifest your intentions and encourage healing. Introduced by channellers like Jose Gabriel Uribe (Agesta), these codes were emanated from beings of light and serve as a powerful spiritual technology to raise human consciousness.

To implement a sacred code, simply recite the numerical sequence—either mentally or out loud—while in a meditative state. With its distinctive blend of numerology, meditation, and energy healing, this practice has garnered numerous positive testimonials, making it a fascinating element of modern esoteric traditions.

Meditation’s Benefits and Sacred Codes:

  • Increase your Self-Love and Self-Esteem (Code: 8 77)
  • Develop your self-confidence (Code: 45 1)
  • Eradicate your sexual karma (Code: 25 16)
  • Cut sexual ties with ex-partners (Code: 57 72)
  • Eliminate your loneliness (Code: 1 11 36)
  • Attract a romantic partner (Code: 25 26)
  • Attract the love of your life (Code: 115 50)
  • Attract your soulmate, your life partner (Code: 71 54 0 0)
  • Eliminate the fear of being rejected (Code: 8 21)
  • Materialize a healthy sexuality (Code: 84 3)
  • Heal the sensation of unworthiness (Code: 59 3)
  • Stop being possessive with your partner (Code: 21 4)
  • Increase your physical and sexual attractiveness (Code: 9 0 4)
  • Strengthen your romantic love (Code: 5 41)
  • Dissolve energies of infidelity and increase loyalty in yourself and surroundings (Code: 21 2)
  • Eliminate the energies of jealousy (Code: 10 15)
  • Invoke the energy of the angels of romance (Code: 9 0 4)
  • Eliminate codependency on destructive relationships (Code: 85 2)
  • Embrace gratitude in all aspects of your life (Code: 33 33)
